versions.content: BswModuleEntity attributes for exchange of modes and triggers The attributes BswModuleEntity . managedModeGroup , BswModuleEn- tity . accessedModeGroup and BswModuleEntity . issuedTrigger specify, that this BswModuleEntity initiates resp. receives mode switches or activates triggers for other modules by using the BSW Scheduler API. This is mandatory information to configure the BSW Scheduler.
